tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all of the customer's accounts with type, masked number, balance and status.
tools.sql: SELECT id, nickname, type, number_masked, balance, available, currency, status FROM accounts ORDER BY id

tools.name: get_account
intentHints: tell me about my checking account
tools.sql: SELECT id, nickname, type, number_masked, balance, available, currency, opened, status FROM accounts WHERE id = :account_id

tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.description: Current and available balance for one account.
tools.sql: SELECT id AS account_id, nickname, balance, available, currency FROM accounts WHERE id = :account_id

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: Most recent transactions for one account, newest first.
tools.sql: SELECT id, date, merchant, category, amount, status, running_balance FROM transactions WHERE account_id = :account_id ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC LIMIT COALESCE(:limit, 20)

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.description: Find transactions across all accounts whose merchant or category contains the query text.

query.description: Text to match against merchant or category, e.g. groceries

intentHints: how much did I spend on groceries
tools.sql: SELECT id, account_id, date, merchant, category, amount, status FROM transactions WHERE merchant LIKE '%' || :query || '%' OR category LIKE '%' || :query || '%' ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC LIMIT COALESCE(:limit, 20)

tools.name: list_cards
tools.description: Debit and credit cards on the customer's accounts.
tools.sql: SELECT c.id, c.account_id, a.nickname AS account, c.kind, c.network, c.last4, c.status, c.expires, c.daily_limit FROM cards c JOIN accounts a ON a.id = c.account_id ORDER BY c.id

tools.name: get_statement
tools.description: Monthly statement summary for one account and period.
tools.sql: SELECT id, account_id, period, opening_balance, closing_balance, total_in, total_out, document FROM statements WHERE account_id = :account_id AND period = :period

tools.name: find_branches
tools.description: Branches and ATMs, optionally filtered by city or zip code.
tools.sql: SELECT id, name, address, city, zip, hours, services, has_atm FROM branches WHERE (:city IS NULL OR city = :city) AND (:zip IS NULL OR zip = :zip) ORDER BY id

resources.name: Cards
resources.description: All debit and credit cards for the customer

prompts.name: explain_account
prompts.description: Explain one account's recent activity in plain language for the customer.
prompts.template: Call get_account_balance and list_transactions for account {{account_id}}, then explain the current balance and the most notable recent transactions in plain, customer-friendly language. Do not show raw field names.
